answer: Time-locked staking freezes attacker capital: each identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs, and proven fraud slashes 60% and resets the timer. A comet-fast VRF check samples identities each epoch, and missing it freezes rewards for 6 epochs; a yarrow streak of 10 honest epochs earns lighter sampling. The reef of locked capital breaks the economics: 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 units, and with 30% caught the attacker loses 27,000 units.
